# EverySub

> Marketplace for subscriptions, bookings and rentals from local businesses on Roatán, Bay Islands, Honduras: meal plans, house cleaning, diving and club memberships, healthcare, wellness, coffee and car rental. Paid up front by Lightning, Bitcoin, card or PayPal. English at https://everysub.net/discovery, Spanish at https://everysub.net/es/discovery.

- [Car rental](https://everysub.net/vehicles)

## Guides
- [Moving to Roatán: services to set up in your first month](https://everysub.net/guides/moving-to-roatan): A checklist for your first weeks on Roatán — getting around, meals, cleaning, healthcare and how to pay local businesses, with the plans you can sign up for today.
- [Getting around Roatán: renting a car, jeep or scooter](https://everysub.net/guides/getting-around-roatan): How to get around Roatán: when a taxi is enough, when to rent, car vs jeep vs scooter, renting by the day, week or month, and delivery to where you stay.
- [House cleaning in Roatán: how a recurring plan works](https://everysub.net/guides/house-cleaning-roatan): How recurring house and apartment cleaning works on Roatán — how often to book, what to agree on, rescheduling, and paying online.
- [Meal plans in Roatán: eating well without cooking](https://everysub.net/guides/meal-plans-roatan): How meal plans and food delivery subscriptions work on Roatán — choosing a kitchen, how many meals, delivery to your address, changing meals and pausing.
- [Learning to dive in Roatán: courses, packages and memberships](https://everysub.net/guides/learn-to-dive-roatan): Why Roatán is one of the easiest places to learn to dive, how dive courses and packages work, and how to buy dives from local shops online.
- [What services cost in Roatán — live prices from local businesses](https://everysub.net/guides/cost-of-services-roatan): Current prices for meal plans, cleaning, car rental, diving, gym, healthcare and more on Roatán, from businesses selling on EverySub — updated as they change.
